newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down at two-month low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down at two-month low vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at a two-month low of 8.2965 on Tuesday from Monday's 8.2956 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai.
Dealers said the head office of a Chinese bank was the biggest U.S. dollar buyer on Tuesday, pushing the yuan down.
The weighted average price on Monday was 8.2956.
The yuan opened a little lower at 8.2957 and consolidated around 8.2956 early in the session, hitting an intraday high of 8.2954. It fell in the rest of session, hitting an intraday low of 8.2981.
Trading was more active than Monday, with most done at about 8.2967, traders said.
Some speculative selling emerged after the yuan rebounded from the day's low of 8.2981 to cap its rise, forcing the yuan to end at a two-month low of 8.2964, he said.
Traders said they expected to see the yuan to go down slightly on Wednesday.
The yuan ended up at 6.7440 from 6.7661 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0710 from 1.0713 against the Hong Kong dollar.
